Read models - authoritative inputs and derived views
|
|-- [O] Controller retains MappingGridDocument
|   |-- scene: LineGridScene
|   |   |-- root: GridBox
|   |   |   |-- Diagram instance -> contentId
|   |   |   `-- Container -> nested GridBoxes
|   |   `-- contents[id]: Diagram
|   |       |-- ASCII + parsed content structure
|   |       `-- Source context -> mappings + captured evidence
|   `-- edges / jumps / sections
|
|-- [O] Controller retains MappingCanvasState
|   |-- selection.items[]: unified diagram / region membership
|   |-- diagramViews: per-diagram folding
|   |-- display: floating selections / projections / conversations / details
|   `-- controls: MappingControls
|       |-- activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
|       `-- surfaces[ownerId]: SelectionSurfaceState
|
|-- [M] nodes(): DisplayNode[] exposes a derived public registry
|   |-- [D] document + presentation + geometry -> display nodes
|   |-- Common: id / read-time version / childIds / expansion
|   |-- Grid nodes: diagram or group; authoritative boxId
|   |   |-- [D] GridBox layout -> column / row / columns / rows
|   |   `-- Diagram instance -> DiagramContent
|   `-- Floating nodes: FloatingBox
|       |-- [D] placement + geometry policy -> position / size
|       |   `-- Canvas or viewport coordinates, measured in pixels
|       |-- SelectionRegion -> selected grid rectangle
|       |-- ProjectedPane -> parent projection owner
|       |-- ConversationPane -> anchor and presentation
|       `-- DetailPane -> retained placement
|
|-- [M] resolveDiagram(diagramId): DiagramView
|   `-- [D] diagram identity + current revision binding -> view
|-- [M] getCanvasSnapshot(): CanvasDocument -> semantic canvas
`-- [M] getSnapshot(): ControllerSnapshot
    |-- [D] context -> contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
    |-- [C] historyService.state(context) -> canUndo / canRedo
    `-- Includes document + canvas interaction state

Display nodes are derived, not a second authoritative document.
Cell bounds and floating pixel bounds are distinct coordinate spaces.
